capabilities: Look up a selected English or Japanese word from a note
Merge dictionary and AI results into one card with reading, meaning and examples
Save words to a word list with a spaced review schedule
Underline saved words in reading view with hover readings
Export cards to Anki or a Spaced Repetition note
extras: Plugin and dictionaries are free with no account; full entries and sentence meaning are billed by the chosen AI provider. API keys are kept in Obsidian's Keychain and do not sync with the vault. Some dictionary sources are web pages, so a layout change can leave a section empty.
problem: Looking up a word while reading and turning it into a reviewable card normally means switching between dictionaries, a flashcard app and the note itself.

relations.evidence: Send to Anki in one command through the AnkiConnect add-on
Export to a Spaced Repetition flashcard note or an Anki import file.

summary: Word-lookup and vocabulary-review tool that builds study cards for English and Japanese words with readings, meanings, examples and audio.
